requirement_text: The system shall prevent a user without EPCS permission from signing a controlled substance prescription.
The system shall block a controlled substance prescription from being marked ready-to-sign or signed by an unauthorized user.
The system shall support identity proofing of a practitioner prior to granting e-prescribing credentials.
The system shall support linking and activation of a two-factor authentication credential for a practitioner.
The system shall require dual authorization, including practitioner two-factor authentication, before granting EPCS permissions to a user account.
The system shall allow an authorized user to create a controlled substance prescription.
The system shall display patient, prescriber, and drug details on the prescription review screen before signing.
The system shall require a controlled substance prescription to be reviewed and marked ready-to-sign before it can be signed or transmitted.
The system shall reject prescription signing attempts that use invalid two-factor authentication.
The system shall allow prescription signing when valid two-factor authentication is provided.
The system shall maintain a sortable report of all controlled substance prescriptions.
The system shall maintain an audit trail capturing creation, readiness, signing, and transmission events for controlled substance prescriptions.
